title: Building Atmanirbhar Geospatial Solutions: Hands-on with MapmyIndia Map APIs, and Sovereign Geospatial platform mGIS

sections.title: Who Should Attend
items: Remote sensing and GIS researchers looking to combine satellite-derived data with high-accuracy Indian base maps.
Government and public sector officials from smart cities, disaster management, agriculture, urban planning and infrastructure departments.
Developers and solution architects building location-aware web and mobile applications.
Students and academicians in geomatics, geoinformatics, civil engineering and computer science.
Industry professionals in logistics, telecom, utilities, mobility and fleet management.
Startups and innovators seeking indigenous, compliant alternatives to foreign geospatial platforms.

sections.title: Benefits for Attendees
items: Hands-on exposure to MapmyIndia Map APIs and SDKs, including maps, search, geocoding, routing and navigation.
An understanding of mGIS as an indigenous enterprise GIS platform for data management, analysis and visualization.
Real-world use cases from governance, disaster response, agriculture and smart mobility.
Networking with MapmyIndia experts and peers from academia, government and industry.

sections.title: Expected Outcomes
items: Ability to integrate MapmyIndia APIs into a working web or mobile application.
Capability to create, analyze and publish geospatial layers using mGIS.
Understanding of how to fuse remote sensing outputs, GIS layers and live IoT feeds into a unified decision-support dashboard.
A clear roadmap for adopting indigenous geospatial technology in their own projects or organizations.
